read_endpoint.name: thread-history-v3
read_endpoint.purpose: Task screen initial render and refresh recovery

action_endpoints.name: assign-agent-v2
action_endpoints.purpose: Assign one AI Agent to the task

action_endpoints.name: thread-message-v2
action_endpoints.purpose: Send a user follow-up message to one AI thread

action_endpoints.name: stop-agent-v2
action_endpoints.purpose: Stop one assigned AI Agent in a task

action_endpoints.name: delete-agent-assignment-v2
action_endpoints.purpose: Remove one assigned AI Agent from a task while preserving history

identity_rules.name: task_id
identity_rules.use: Group all AI thread history for one task screen

identity_rules.name: conversation_id
identity_rules.use: Render one Agent conversation card; same value means reply chain, different value means separate card even for same agent_id

identity_rules.name: thread_id
identity_rules.use: Route v2 user messages and render sub-run blocks inside a conversation card

identity_rules.name: parent_thread_id
identity_rules.meaning: Source thread for a follow-up run
identity_rules.use: Nest a follow-up run under the original Agent comment when present

identity_rules.name: assignment_id
identity_rules.use: Manage execution status and stop/delete targeting

identity_rules.name: run_id
identity_rules.use: Deduplicate live progress together with assignment_id and seq

identity_rules.name: message_id
identity_rules.use: Render messages without collapsing repeated user bodies or repeated progress text

grouping_rules: Agent comment card key is conversation_id, not thread_id.
A new participant-dropdown reassignment creates a new conversation_id even when agent_id is the same.
A user reply submitted to an existing thread keeps the existing conversation_id.
parent_thread_id is present only when a follow-up run is derived from an existing thread.
provider, runtime_kind, label, and agent name must never be used for dedupe.
agent_snapshot_rules: Each thread may carry agent_snapshot_id instead of an embedded agent snapshot.
The screen resolves agent_snapshots[thread.agent_snapshot_id] for display.
Historical cards must keep the captured snapshot even if the current agent settings change.

message_roles.meaning: User follow-up instruction inside the AI thread
Runtime progress log, ordered by seq inside assignment_id and run_id
Agent status or final result message

sse_handling_rules: Open one task-level SSE stream from the v2 thread-stream-subscription response.
Filter payloads by task_id, agent_id, thread_id, and run_id.
Use assignment_id + run_id + seq as the progress dedupe key when assignment_id is present.
SSE is a live update input; v3 thread history remains the refresh recovery truth.
Do not revive a terminal assignment when a late runtime progress event arrives.

loop.observation: The AI Agent client API doc repeated contract, generated-client, smoke, deployment, and runtime rules as prose while the machine-readable mirrors already existed.
loop.hypothesis: A compact SSOT gate can prove the OpenAPI/generated client/smoke matrix mirror and keep required runtime/deployment strings visible without using prose as truth.
loop.execute: Generate this reader doc from the manifest and run the aiagentclientapi verifier in CI.
loop.evaluate: The verifier checks contract file presence, OpenAPI operation counts, v1/v2 split, generated path coverage, smoke matrix parity, source anchors, generated doc freshness, and CLI evidence output.
loop.retrospective: This slice proves the public control-plane mirror and generated-client evidence; canonical domain changes still start in riido-contracts.
